# qualys_virtual_scanner (Resource)

A Qualys virtual scanner appliance.

This resource covers the Qualys side of provisioning: it registers the appliance
and exports the `activation_code` needed to personalise the appliance VM.
Deploying that VM belongs to whichever infrastructure provider hosts it, which
consumes the code exported here.

Only virtual appliances can be created and deleted through the API. Physical
appliances are registered out of band and can only be read (see the
`qualys_scanner_appliances` data source).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qualys_virtual_scanner" "dmz" {
  name       = "dmz-scanner-01"
  network_id = qualys_network.dmz.id

  vlan {
    vlan_id = "100"
    ip      = "10.20.100.5"
    netmask = "255.255.255.0"
    name    = "dmz-vlan"
  }
}
```

## Provisioning spans two providers

1. **Configure in Qualys** — this resource. Returns an activation code.
2. **Deploy the appliance VM** — vSphere, AWS, Azure, GCP, … using that code.
3. **Activation** — the VM personalises itself and connects. Nothing to do.
4. **Readiness** — poll until the appliance reports Online.

Only step 1 belongs here. Step 2 is why `activation_code` is exported.

## The activation code cannot be recovered

Qualys returns the activation code at creation, and from the list API only until
the appliance activates. After that the value is no longer available.

Terraform stores the code it received and does **not** clear it when Qualys stops
returning one — otherwise the first apply after activation would erase it. But if
the code is lost from state before the appliance VM is deployed, it cannot be
retrieved; the appliance would need recreating.

## Waiting for the appliance

`wait_for_online` is only useful when the appliance VM is deployed in the same
apply. Qualys checks appliance health every four hours, so a newly activated
appliance may take a long time to report Online — size `wait_for_online_timeout`
for that, not for seconds.

## VLANs and static routes are authoritative

The Qualys API replaces the whole VLAN and route lists on every update; it has no
add or remove variants. Declaring a `vlan` or `static_route` block therefore
makes Terraform authoritative over that list, and anything not declared is
removed.

Omit the block entirely to leave VLANs or routes that are managed elsewhere
untouched — the provider only sends the lists it has been given.

## Deletion has side effects

Qualys refuses to delete an appliance while it is running scans. Deleting one
also removes it from any asset groups and **deactivates scan schedules that
referenced it**. Qualys applies those changes itself; Terraform warns about them
but cannot prevent them.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **name** (String) Name of the scanner appliance.

### Optional

- **asset_group_id** (String) Asset group to create the appliance in. Required for Unit Manager and Scanner accounts; must be omitted for Manager accounts. Changing this forces replacement.
- **comments** (String)
- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **network_id** (String) Qualys network to assign the appliance to. Requires Manager privileges.
- **polling_interval** (Number) How often the appliance polls Qualys, in seconds (60–360).
- **static_route** (Block List) Static routes configured on the appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--static_route))
- **vlan** (Block List) VLANs configured on the appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vlan))
- **wait_for_online** (Boolean) Wait for the appliance to come online before completing. Defaults to `false`.
- **wait_for_online_timeout** (String) Go duration. Defaults to `30m`.

### Read-Only

- **activation_code** (String, Sensitive) Personalisation code for deploying the appliance VM.
- **heartbeats_missed** (String)
- **running_scan_count** (Number)
- **software_version** (String)
- **status** (String)
- **up_to_date** (Boolean) Whether signature and module versions match the latest Qualys has published.
- **uuid** (String)
- **vulnsigs_version** (String)

<a id="nestedblock--vlan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlan`

Required:

- **ip** (String)
- **name** (String)
- **netmask** (String)
- **vlan_id** (String)

<a id="nestedblock--static_route"></a>
### Nested Schema for `static_route`

- **name** (String)
- **netmask** (String)

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_virtual_scanner.dmz 11223
```
